loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

    cl = sum(1 for c in cust if c['churn'] and c['churn'][:7] == ym)
    cend = sum(1 for c in cust if mrr_at(c, ym) > 0)
    mrows.append([ym, prev, new, exp, con, chn, end, new + exp - con - chn, end * 12, nl, cl, cend])

## What Lumen does
Lumen Labs sells **Lumen Insights**, a customer-feedback and product-insights analytics platform for product teams. It ingests feedback from support tickets, app-store reviews, surveys, NPS, call transcripts and in-product events, clusters it into themes with ML, and links themes to usage and revenue so teams can prioritise the roadmap. - Founded 2022 in Bengaluru by **Aarav Menon (CEO)** and **Priya Raman (CTO)**. HQ Bengaluru; remote staff in the US and EU.

| Tier | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|

| Business | $55 per seat, min $3,500 | Roles & permissions, revenue linking, priority support |

Product orgs of 8-150 PMs/designers/CS staff at B2B software or digital-product companies with 100-2,000 employees, drowning in unstructured feedback and needing security assurances (SSO, SOC 2) as they move upmarket.

# Employee Handbook - Lumen Labs

_Fictional demo data. Version 3.2, effective 2026-04-01. Owner: Nisha Verma, Head of People & Operations._

## 1. Values
Customer truth first. Own the outcome. Write it down. Ship small, learn fast. Be kind and direct.

## 2. Employment basics
- Working hours: core hours 11:00-16:00 IST (overlap with US/EU colleagues by agreement); 40 hours/week.
- Probation: 3 months for L1-L3, 6 months for L4+. Notice period: 30 days during probation, 60 days after (90 days for L5-L6).
- Employment types: Full-time, Part-time (pro-rated benefits). Contractors are engaged under a separate agreement.
- Performance cycle: reviews each April, mid-year check-in each October. Ratings: Exceeds, Meets, Developing.
- Compensation: see `hr/salary-bands.md`. Salaries are paid on the last working day of the month.

## 3. Benefits (India)
Group health insurance for employee, spouse and two children (INR 5 lakh cover, parental top-up available); personal accident cover; PF as per statutory rules; INR 30,000 annual learning budget; meal and internet reimbursement INR 2,500/month; home-office set-up INR 25,000 on joining.
US/EU staff receive local statutory benefits plus an equivalent health stipend via a PEO/EOR.

## 4. Equity
ESOP grants by band at offer; 4-year vest, 1-year cliff, 10-year exercise window after leaving for employees with 2+ years.

## 5. Conduct
Zero tolerance for harassment, discrimination or retaliation. Concerns go to the Head of People (nisha.verma@lumenlabs.example) or the confidential ethics line. Conflicts of interest and outside work must be disclosed.

## 6. Confidentiality and security
Customer data is handled under least-privilege; production access requires SSO + MFA and is logged. No customer data on personal devices. Report suspected incidents to security@lumenlabs.example within 1 hour. See `legal/compliance-status.md`.

## 7. Expenses and travel
Pre-approve travel with your manager; economy flights; expense claims within 30 days via the finance tool. Client entertainment capped at $75/person.

## 8. On-call
Engineering on-call rota (weekly). On-call allowance INR 6,000/week for India staff. Currently only two engineers are on the platform rota; the Senior SRE hire (R-101) is intended to fix this.

## 9. Leaving Lumen
Exit interview, knowledge transfer plan, return of assets, final settlement within 45 days of last day.

Related: `leave-policy.md`, `remote-work-policy.md`, `hr/onboarding-checklist.md`.

# Leave Policy

_Fictional demo data. Effective 2026-04-01. Balances per employee are in `hr/bamboohr-export/employees.csv` (`annual_leave_balance_days`)._

## Annual (paid) leave
- India-based employees: 24 days per calendar year; US/EU employees: 25 days (plus statutory public holidays).
- Accrual: monthly, pro-rated for joiners. Joiners after July receive half the annual allotment.
- Carry-forward: up to 5 days into the next year; the rest lapses on 31 March. No cash-out except on exit (up to 10 days).
- Request via the HR system at least 5 working days ahead for 3+ days of leave; manager approval within 2 working days.
- Blackout guidance: customer-facing teams avoid overlapping leave on the same account during renewal month.

## Sick leave
- 12 days per year, no carry-forward. Medical certificate required for 3+ consecutive days.

## Parental leave
- Maternity: 26 weeks paid (India statutory), extra 4 weeks company-paid. Paternity/partner: 4 weeks paid. Adoption: same as parental.
- Can be taken flexibly within 12 months of birth/adoption.

## Other leave
- Bereavement: 5 days (immediate family), 2 days (extended).
- Marriage leave: 5 days. Comp-off: 1 day off for approved weekend/holiday on-call or incident work (expires in 60 days).
- Unpaid leave: up to 30 days with Head of People approval.
- Public holidays: 12 per year (India calendar) or local calendar for non-India staff.

## Incident time off
After a P1 incident response of more than 6 hours outside working hours, engineers get a rest day next working day without drawing leave.

## Questions
Head of People & Operations: Nisha Verma. Recruiting/People partner: Jaya Thomas.

After a P1 incident response of more than 6 hours outside working hours, engineers get a rest day next working day without drawing leave.

# Sales Playbook - Lumen Insights

_Fictional demo data. Owner: Sofia Alvarez, VP Sales. Updated 2026-09-15._

## ICP
B2B software or digital-product companies, 100-2,000 employees, product org of 8-150 people, using 3+ feedback sources (support desk, surveys, app stores, NPS) and no single source of truth. Upmarket segment (Enterprise) needs SAML SSO, SOC 2 and data-residency answers.

## Personas
| Persona | Cares about | Typical objection |
|---|---|---|
| VP/Head of Product (economic buyer) | Roadmap confidence, revenue impact | "We already have spreadsheets + Jira" |
| Product Manager (champion) | Time saved on synthesis | "Will it understand our domain?" |
| Head of CS / Support | Closing the loop, ticket volume | "Another tool to integrate" |
| InfoSec / IT | SSO, SOC 2, data residency, uptime | "No SAML = no go" |
| Finance / Procurement | Price, term, auto-renew | "Need a discount for annual prepay" |

## Discovery questions
1. Where does customer feedback live today, and who reads it?
2. How do you decide what goes on the roadmap? What happened to your last "big bet"?
3. What would a 20% faster synthesis cycle be worth to the team?
4. Who needs to sign off on security? What do they require (SSO, SOC 2, residency)?
5. When does your current tool/contract renew? What is the cost of doing nothing?
6. Who else is evaluating? What would make you choose us?

## Objection handling
- **No SAML SSO today:** be honest; SAML + SCIM is scheduled for GA in Nov 2026 (target date, not a guarantee). Offer a written roadmap clause in the order form (approved only by the VP Sales) and interim security controls (MFA, IP allow-lists). Do not promise a date in the contract beyond Q4 2026.
- **SOC 2:** Type I available; Type II observation window runs to Dec 2026, report expected Feb 2027. Share bridge letter and pen-test summary under NDA.
- **Reliability (post Aug 14 incident):** share the RCA, status page and the remediation plan (reliability hires, failover changes). Offer SLA credits per contract.
- **Price too high:** anchor on revenue-linking use case; propose a smaller Starter/Growth team scope before discounting.
- **Competitor X is cheaper:** compare on integrations, theme accuracy, and revenue-linking; do not disparage.

## Pricing and discount rules
- List: see `company/overview.md`. Annual prepay = 10% max standard discount.
- Up to 10%: AE approval. 11-20%: VP Sales approval. >20% or multi-year price lock: CEO + Head of Finance approval.
- No discounts on Enterprise SLA/security features; concessions should be non-price (extra seats pilot, onboarding hours).
- Renewal uplift: default +5% (capped at 7% by most MSAs); drop the uplift only for Critical/At-risk accounts with VP Sales approval.
- Payment: net-15 monthly by card/ACH; net-30 annual invoice. Payment terms longer than net-30 need Finance approval.
- Order forms and MSA redlines go through Legal (Lena Fischer) before signature.

## Process and stages
Qualified (BANT + pain) -> Demo -> Proposal -> Negotiation -> Contracting -> Closed Won/Lost. Forecast categories: Commit (>=80%), Best Case, Pipeline. Log notes and next step in HubSpot within 24 hours of each call.

## Expansion and renewal motions
- Start renewal motions 120 days before term end with the CSM; confirm notice deadlines from `legal/contracts-register.csv`.
- For at-risk renewals, AE + CSM + exec sponsor (Rohan Kapoor) form a joint plan; check Zendesk escalations and Stripe payment status before every call.

# Churn Log - 2026

_Fictional demo data. Churned MRR ties to `finance/stripe-export/mrr-by-month.csv` and `customers.csv` (status = churned)._

| Date | Customer (ID) | MRR | Segment | Reason | CSM | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-12 | Blue Ox Studio (CUST-1025) | $600 | SMB | Budget cut | Chris Doyle (then: Nandini Rao) | Media startup reduced tool stack. |
| 2026-05-20 | Ferro Tools (CUST-1028) | $800 | SMB | Low adoption | Chris Doyle | Two failed payments in April before churn. |
| 2026-07-15 | Redwood Commerce (CUST-1020) | $3,100 | Mid-Market | **Missing SAML SSO** | Nandini Rao | Security policy required SSO; asked in Jun (ZD-10012) and Jul (ZD-10133). Renewal deal D-3023 lost. |
| 2026-08-28 | Stratus Cloudworks (CUST-1030) | $2,800 | Mid-Market | **Reliability incident (Aug 14)** | Nandini Rao | Two P1/P2 tickets, credits issued, still left. Had contracted $600 in June. Renewal D-3024 lost. |
| 2026-09-21 | Vantage Mobility (CUST-1032) | $2,200 | Mid-Market | **Champion left** | Chris Doyle | Admin/champion left in Aug (ZD-10301); new head of product kept incumbent tool. Renewal D-3025 lost. |

## Totals
- 2026 YTD churned MRR: $9,500 across 5 logos. Q3: **$8,100 across 3 mid-market logos** (Q2: $800).
- Q3 lost ARR from the three renewals: $97,200. Ending MRR fell from $83,900 (Jun) to $80,000 (Sep).
- TTM GRR 87.4%, NRR 97.9%.

## Themes and lessons
1. **Enterprise-readiness gap:** SSO/SAML was cited in two lost new-logo deals (Granite Bay Analytics, Waverly Systems) in addition to Redwood. Engineering owner: R-103 hire; launch Nov 2026.
2. **Reliability:** the Aug 14 ingestion outage (root cause: failed DB failover and under-provisioned on-call) hit Stratus, Northwind, Tessera and Meridian hardest. Fix list: automated failover tests, status page, Senior SRE hire (R-101).
3. **Single-threaded relationships:** Vantage and others relied on one champion. CSM playbook now requires a second stakeholder per Business/Enterprise account.
4. **Capacity:** two CSMs carry 14 accounts each; open CSM role R-102 (verbal offer to Maya Iyengar).

## Accounts currently at risk
Northwind Logistics (Critical), Meridian Travel and Fjord Commerce (At-risk); details in `account-health.csv`. Northwind's contract has a 60-day non-renewal notice with a deadline of 2026-10-16 and a chronic-SLA termination clause; see `legal/contracts-register.csv`.

# Brand and Positioning

_Fictional demo data. Owner: Marcus Chen, Head of Marketing; product marketing: Ira Chopra._

## Positioning statement
For product teams at B2B software companies who are drowning in unstructured customer feedback, **Lumen Insights** turns support tickets, reviews, surveys and calls into prioritised, revenue-linked product decisions - without a data team.

## Messaging pillars
1. **One source of truth for feedback** - connect every channel in a day.
2. **From themes to revenue** - see which themes affect renewals and expansion.
3. **Close the loop** - route insights to Jira and notify customers when shipped.
4. **Trusted at scale** - security and reliability for growing, regulated teams (SSO/SAML, SOC 2 Type II in progress, status page). _Pillar 4 is the Q4 focus._

## Tone of voice
Clear, calm, evidence-led. Practical over hype. Short sentences, concrete numbers. No fear-based copy, no jargon like "synergy". Humble about gaps: say "on the roadmap for Nov 2026", never imply shipped features that are not.

## Visual identity
Warm amber (#F5A524) on deep ink (#0F1B2D), generous white space, product screenshots over stock photos.

## Competitors (fictional)
| Competitor | Strength | Weakness vs Lumen |
|---|---|---|
| SignalDeck | Mature enterprise features, SAML/SCIM | Expensive, slow to set up |
| Feedbackly Pro | Strong survey tooling | Weak theme clustering |
| InsightHive | Low price | Limited integrations, no revenue linking |
| Spreadsheets + Jira | Free, familiar | Manual, no clustering |

## Proof points
- Customers report 60% less time on feedback synthesis (customer survey, n=14).
- Brightwave Health customer story (published Sep 2026).
- Benchmark Report 2026: 640 downloads in Q2.

## Claims policy
No unreleased feature claims; reference SOC 2 Type I only until the Type II report is issued. Reliability claims require Platform sign-off after the Aug 14 incident. All customer names in public material need written consent.

# Master Subscription Agreement (MSA) - Template

_Fictional demo template, not legal advice. Owner: Lena Fischer, Legal & Compliance Counsel. Version 2026.2._

Parties: Lumen Labs Private Limited ("Lumen") and [Customer legal name] ("Customer"). Effective Date: [date]. Order Forms reference this MSA.

1. **Service.** Lumen provides the Lumen Insights SaaS platform per the Order Form. Lumen may update the service provided core functionality is not materially reduced.
2. **Fees and payment.** Fees per Order Form; invoiced monthly or annually in USD; net-15 (monthly) or net-30 (annual). Late amounts accrue 1% per month. Renewal uplift capped at 7% unless otherwise agreed.
3. **Term and renewal.** Initial term per Order Form (default 12 months). **Auto-renews for successive 12-month terms** unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least [30/60/90] days before term end (standard: 30; enterprise negotiable up to 90).
4. **Service levels.** Monthly uptime target 99.5% (Enterprise 99.9%). Credits: 5% of monthly fee per 0.5-point shortfall, capped at 30%; credits are sole remedy except under clause 9.3.
5. **Customer data.** Customer owns Customer Data; Lumen processes it only to provide the service under the DPA. Data export available on request within 30 days of termination; deletion within 90 days.
6. **Security.** Lumen maintains a security programme aligned to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls; encryption in transit and at rest; annual penetration test; incident notification without undue delay and within 72 hours of confirmation.
7. **Confidentiality and IP.** Mutual confidentiality for 5 years after termination. Lumen retains all IP in the service; Customer grants a licence to use feedback and aggregated, de-identified data to improve the service.
8. **Warranties and disclaimers.** Service performs materially per documentation; otherwise provided "as is".
9. **Liability and termination.**
   9.1 Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.
   9.2 Each party's aggregate liability is capped at fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim (negotiated variants: 2x for regulated customers; super-cap for data breach).
   9.3 Customer may terminate for chronic service-level failure (uptime below 99.5% in 3 of any 6 consecutive months) on 30 days' notice and receive a pro-rata refund. _Negotiated clause; present in the Northwind Logistics agreement._
   9.4 Either party may terminate for uncured material breach (30 days).
10. **Indemnity.** Lumen indemnifies against third-party IP claims; Customer against misuse claims.
11. **Governing law.** Delaware (US customers), England and Wales (UK), Karnataka (India), other as agreed; disputes via good-faith escalation, then courts of the governing jurisdiction.
12. **General.** Entire agreement; amendments in writing; assignment only with consent except in a merger.

Approval rules: any change to clauses 3, 4, 9 or governing law requires Legal approval; liability above 2x fees requires CEO approval.

# Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) - Template

_Fictional demo template, not legal advice. Owner: Lena Fischer. Version 2026.1. Use for prospects, vendors and candidates (unilateral version exists for candidates)._

**Parties:** Lumen Labs Private Limited, Bengaluru ("Lumen") and [Counterparty] ("Counterparty"). **Effective date:** [date]. **Purpose:** [evaluation of a potential business relationship / security review].

1. **Confidential Information** means non-public information disclosed in any form that is marked confidential or reasonably should be understood as confidential, including product roadmaps, security reports (SOC 2, pen-test summaries), pricing and customer data.
2. **Exclusions.** Information that is public, already known, independently developed, or lawfully received from a third party without restriction.
3. **Obligations.** Use only for the Purpose; protect with at least reasonable care; disclose only to personnel and advisers who need to know and are bound by equivalent obligations.
4. **Compelled disclosure.** Permitted if required by law, with prior notice where lawful.
5. **Term.** Disclosure period 2 years from the effective date; confidentiality obligations survive 5 years (trade secrets: as long as they remain trade secrets).
6. **Return/destruction** on request within 30 days, except archival copies required by law.
7. **No licence / no obligation** to enter a transaction. Roadmap items are not commitments.
8. **Security reports.** Lumen SOC 2 and pen-test documents are shared only under this NDA, watermarked and non-redistributable.
9. **Remedies.** Equitable relief available. Governing law: Karnataka, India (or the Counterparty's jurisdiction by agreement, approved by Legal).
10. **Signature.** E-signature accepted. Sales may sign unmodified templates up to Level-1 sensitivity; any redlines go to Legal.

Typical turnaround: 1 business day for unmodified, 3 business days with redlines.

# Lumen Labs - Company Context Index

> **This is fictional demo data for Lumen Labs, a made-up B2B SaaS startup. It is read-only and shared across all users. Do not edit it, and never present it as real company data. "Today" in this dataset is 2026-10-12; data runs through 30 Sep 2026 with October partial.**

Lumen Labs sells Lumen Insights (customer-feedback analytics). 40 employees, $80,000 MRR, 28 customers, $6.02M cash, ~20 months runway. Customers are keyed by `customer_id` (CUST-xxxx) and employees by `employee_id` (Exxx) in every file.

## Start here, by bot
| Bot | Questions | Read first |
|---|---|---|
| CFO / Finance | MRR, ARR, churn, cash, runway, burn, budget vs actual, failed payments | `finance/summary.md`, `finance/stripe-export/mrr-by-month.csv`, `failed-payments.csv`, `customers.csv` |
| HR | headcount, org, comp bands, leave, open roles, candidates, policies, onboarding | `hr/bamboohr-export/employees.csv`, `hr/salary-bands.md`, `hr/open-roles.md`, `hr/greenhouse-export/candidates.csv`, `hr/policies/*` |
| Sales | pipeline, forecast, deal status, pricing/discount rules, objections | `sales/hubspot-export/deals.csv`, `sales/q4-forecast.md`, `sales/sales-playbook.md` |
| Customer Success | account health, renewals, escalations, churn reasons | `customer-success/account-health.csv`, `zendesk-export/tickets.csv`, `churn-log.md` |
| Marketing | campaign ROI, signups by channel, positioning, Q4 plan | `marketing/campaigns.csv`, `signups-by-channel.csv`, `brand-and-positioning.md`, `content-calendar-q4.md` |
| Legal | contract renewals, notice deadlines, liability, templates, compliance | `legal/contracts-register.csv`, `legal/compliance-status.md`, `msa-template.md`, `nda-template.md` |
| Assistant / Orchestrator | company background, priorities, cross-functional questions | `company/overview.md`, then the relevant function above |

Cross-functional questions (e.g. "what is the status of Northwind Logistics?") need: Stripe `customers.csv` + `failed-payments.csv`, `account-health.csv`, Zendesk `tickets.csv`, HubSpot `deals.csv` and `contracts-register.csv`, joined by `customer_id`.

## File map
### company/
- `company/overview.md` - what Lumen does, pricing tiers, ICP, founders, funding, org summary, metrics snapshot, Q4 2026 OKRs (all bots)

### finance/ (CFO)
- `finance/stripe-export/mrr-by-month.csv` - Oct 2024-Sep 2026: beginning, new, expansion, contraction, churned, ending MRR, customer counts
- `finance/stripe-export/customers.csv` - every customer ever (28 active, 9 churned): plan, seats, MRR, status, country
- `finance/stripe-export/failed-payments.csv` - failed invoice payments, status and retry dates
- `finance/summary.md` - cash, burn, runway, 6-month P&L, Q3 budget vs actual, collections watch

### hr/ (HR)
- `hr/bamboohr-export/employees.csv` - all 40 employees: title, dept, manager, location, start date, band, salary (USD), leave balance
- `hr/salary-bands.md` - bands L1-L6 with USD ranges and comp rules
- `hr/open-roles.md` - 4 open roles with rationale and pipeline counts
- `hr/greenhouse-export/candidates.csv` - 19 candidates, stages, interviewers
- `hr/policies/employee-handbook.md`, `leave-policy.md`, `remote-work-policy.md` - policies
- `hr/onboarding-checklist.md` - new-hire checklist

### sales/ (Sales)
- `sales/hubspot-export/deals.csv` - 28 deals (open, closed won, closed lost) with ARR, owner, notes
- `sales/sales-playbook.md` - ICP, personas, discovery, objections, discount rules
- `sales/q4-forecast.md` - Q4 bookings forecast, renewals due, scenarios

### customer-success/ (Customer Success)
- `customer-success/account-health.csv` - health score, usage trend, NPS, CSM, renewal date, risk flag for 28 active + 3 Q3 churned accounts
- `customer-success/zendesk-export/tickets.csv` - 35 recent tickets, including open P1 escalations
- `customer-success/churn-log.md` - 2026 churned accounts and reasons

### marketing/ (Marketing)
- `marketing/campaigns.csv` - Q2-Q3 actuals and Q4 budgets: spend, leads, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline
- `marketing/signups-by-channel.csv` - monthly trial signups by channel, Oct 2025-Sep 2026
- `marketing/brand-and-positioning.md` - positioning, pillars, tone, competitors
- `marketing/content-calendar-q4.md` - Q4 plan incl. SSO and Enterprise Readiness launch

### legal/ (Legal)
- `legal/contracts-register.csv` - key customer and vendor contracts: renewal, auto-renew, notice period and deadline, liability cap, SLA
- `legal/msa-template.md`, `legal/nda-template.md` - templates
- `legal/compliance-status.md` - SOC 2 Type II progress, GDPR, India DPDP, HIPAA, open items

## The story in the data (for demo cross-checks)
Q3 2026 churn rose ($8,100 MRR): Redwood Commerce (no SSO), Stratus Cloudworks (Aug 14 outage), Vantage Mobility (champion left). Northwind Logistics (CUST-1021, $7,200 MRR, largest account) is Critical: failed payment, 2 open P1s, low health, renewal 2026-12-15 with a notice deadline of 2026-10-16. Open roles (Senior SRE, CSM) respond to it, and a Q4 SSO/enterprise launch is planned in marketing.
